observations: Photo 0 shows a swivel office chair with a fabric/mesh-looking back and a padded seat.
The chair has a silver metal base with 5 legs and caster wheels.
The seat and arm area look intact in the photo; no obvious torn fabric is visible.
The seller’s text says “Bent office chair,” but the photo does not clearly show a bent frame or bent legs.

claims.claim: Bent office chair available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not clearly show the bending; the frame/legs are not shown from angles that confirm a bend.
No photo evidence of the location (Opebi) is visible.

risks.risk: The chair may be bent in a way that affects stability (wobble) or alignment, which is not confirmable from this single angle.
risks.proof: A short video from the side and front showing the chair on a flat floor while someone gently rocks it, plus a close-up of the base/legs for any permanent bend.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as damaged/possibly not stable (worst case: needs repair or unsafe to use).

risks.risk: Caster wheels or the base may be damaged (cracked stem, bent wheel mounts), causing uneven rolling.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all 5 casters and the underside of the base; then a clip showing the chair rolling smoothly in a straight line.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if casters/base may need replacement.

risks.risk: Height adjustment (gas lift) may be faulty or weak, which cannot be tested from the photo.
risks.proof: A clip showing the lever being pressed and the seat height changing smoothly, then holding position without sinking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if height adjustment may not work.

risks.risk: Back/tilt mechanism may be loose or not functioning.
risks.proof: A clip showing the tilt/recline movement (if present) and that it locks/returns properly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if tilt/locking is not reliable.

proof_requests: Front + side video on a flat floor showing whether the chair wobbles/rocks (to confirm the “bent” claim).
Close-up photos of the underside/base and all 5 legs/casters.
Video of height adjustment working smoothly and holding position.
Video of any tilt/recline mechanism (if present) and whether it locks/returns properly.
response.reason: The seller claims the chair is bent, but the single photo does not clearly confirm the damage or its severity. Without proof of stability/adjustment/tilt condition, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
